verdict.rationale: BugSnag's docs describe automatic grouping of events into a single error by error class, file and line number of the top in-project stack frame, and show the reason for each grouping in the error view. The pack has no evidence of user-customizable grouping (custom fingerprints, grouping rules, or merging and splitting errors). Assignment rules and before-notify ignore callbacks are adjacent features, not grouping customization. missing for 10: documented custom grouping/fingerprint overrides, merge/split controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of grouping quality.
